hero.title: Water, schools and healthcare{br}for rural Senegal
hero.subtitle: We work with communities in Kédougou, Tambacounda and Louga to build wells, support schools and run health clinics.

programs.title: Our programs in Senegal
programs.description: We focus on the areas where help is needed most.

programs.healthcareDescription: Providing medical supplies, health screenings, and awareness campaigns.

welcome.originText: We learned this word greeting people in Casamance, southern Senegal. We adopted it to name the foundation for the weight of its meaning and the closeness in the way it is spoken.
welcome.visionText: A society that lives in peace can imagine a future. We want to contribute our grain of sand to that future: water, schools and healthcare, on the ground and alongside those who live there.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Data controller: Asociacion Fundació Kassumay, registered in Spain's National Registry of Associations. This notice complies with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).
privacy.infoCollectDescription: We collect only the data necessary to manage your account and your donations:
privacy.personalDataDescription: name and email address you provide when registering or donating.
privacy.usageDataDescription: pages visited, session duration, and device type, collected through technical cookies.
privacy.donationDataDescription: card or bank details are handled by Givebutter as a data processor; they are never stored on our servers.
privacy.useCommunicate: To keep you informed about the progress of the projects you have funded.
privacy.useImprove: To compile anonymous usage statistics for the site.
privacy.dataProtectionDescription: All communications are encrypted with TLS. Database access is restricted through Supabase Row Level Security and the application's internal role system.
privacy.yourRightsDescription: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, and objection by writing to {email}. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
privacy.contactDescription: For any privacy-related enquiry, write to us at {email}.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.organizationDescription: Asociacion Fundació Kassumay, registered in Spain's National Registry of Associations under the Ministry of the Interior (Section 1). Registered office in Barcelona. We run development projects in the regions of Kedougou, Tambacounda, and Louga (Senegal).
legal.websiteDescription: This website is for informational and fundraising purposes. Content may be updated without prior notice.
legal.copyrightNoticeDescription: All text, photographs, logos, and source code are the property of the association or are used under licence. Partial reproduction for informational purposes is permitted provided the source is credited.
legal.copyrightImages: Photographs: sourced from the association's archive or used with permission from partner organisations.
legal.copyrightCode: Source code: released under MIT licence where applicable.
legal.externalLinksDescription: This site links to Givebutter for donation processing and to social media platforms. We are not responsible for the content or privacy policies of those services.
legal.liabilityDescription: We do our best to keep the information on this site up to date, but we do not guarantee that it is free from errors. Use of the site is at the user's own risk.
legal.contactDescription: For legal matters, write to us at {email}.

contribute.intro: Fundació Kassumay keeps going thanks to people like you and any help is invaluable. Membership fees go entirely to funding our projects, since our team is made up exclusively of volunteers.
contribute.title: How you can contribute
contribute.chooseOption: You can collaborate in different ways, choose the option that suits you best.

member.text: A regular contribution helps us plan projects in the long term. With your support we keep improving the quality of life of the communities we work with.
member.title: Become a member

donate.text: Every bit counts and any contribution, no matter how small, is welcome.
donate.title: Make a donation

legacy.text: Even when you are no longer around, you can still help. You can name FUNDACIÓ KASSUMAY as heir, joint holder or legatee of your estate; it doesn't matter how big or small, every contribution counts. You can leave cash, movable or real estate assets and even financial securities, depending on your circumstances and wishes.
legacy.title: Inheritance and legacies

team.title: Join our team
team.text: Our team is made up of volunteers from different backgrounds and we believe everyone has something to offer. That's why any proposal is welcome. Come and meet us and tell us how you can help.

companies.text: We believe companies are an important driver for social change. They can collaborate financially, promote solidarity initiatives and involve their employees. Let's talk about it.
companies.title: Solidary companies

footnotes.individualPre: All people making occasional or regular donations (members) receive a tax certificate with the contributions made during the year.
footnotes.individualBold: Individuals can deduct 80% of the first €150 donated and 35% of the remainder once €150 is exceeded.
footnotes.individualPost: If donations have been made to the same account for at least 3 years for an equal or greater amount each year, this deduction rises to 35%.
footnotes.companiesPre: All collaborating companies receive a Tax Certificate with the contributions made during the year.
footnotes.companiesBold: Companies may deduct up to 40% in their corporate tax liability, with a limit of 10% of the gross taxable base. Self-employed workers can deduct up to 25% of their personal income tax.

foundation.title: The Foundation
foundation.intro: Fundació Kassumay is a non-profit NGO working for the integral development of the people, mainly in Lower Casamance (Senegal), although we also operate elsewhere. This year marks our 25th anniversary.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.commitment: Since we ask society for support to advance our mission, it is our duty to provide a clear, detailed and transparent account of how the contributions entrusted to us are used, working at all times with professionalism, rigour and consistency.
transparency.controls: That is why we follow a set of rules, controls and indicators that uphold this commitment.
transparency.legalIntro: We are subject to the current legislation on foundations of the Generalitat de Catalunya:

laws.law1: Law 4/2008, on the third book of the Civil Code of Catalonia, relating to legal persons.
laws.law2: Law 7/2012, of 15 June, amending the third book of the Civil Code of Catalonia regarding legal persons.
laws.law3: ORDRE JUS/152/2018, of 12 September, setting the level of compliance for foundations and associations declared of public interest with the transparency instruments under Law 21/2014.
laws.law4: Law 21/2014, on the protectorate of foundations and verification of activity of associations declared of public interest.
laws.law5: Law 49/2002, on the tax regime for non-profit entities and the tax incentives for patronage.

transparency.amlLink: Law 10/2010 on Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing

partners.independence: Fundació Kassumay is a foundation governed exclusively by independent individuals from different professional and business backgrounds, with no political or institutional dependency.
